items.question: What is the UAE excise tax rate on tobacco and tobacco products under Cabinet Decision No. 52 of 2019?
items.fact: Tobacco products excise tax rate is 100 percent.

items.question: By which day must a registered business file its UAE excise tax return?
items.gold: By the 15th day following the end of each tax period.
items.fact: Excise tax returns due 15th day after each tax period ends.
